intro: Return to Verner is an Alliance errand carrying a bulky delivery of fifty freshly forged horseshoes back to Lakeshire. Entrusted by Goldshire's blacksmith, Smith Argus, you must return across the border into Redridge to hand the crate over to an eager Verner Osgood.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Ok, I'll give him his 50 horseshoes...
Here they are, all boxed up and ready to go! Tell Verner it was a pleasure doing business, and be sure he reads the note attached to this crate!

clips.title: Progress
paras: Great, you're back! Did you get the shoes?

clips.title: Completion
paras: Thank you, this really helps me out.
But what's this? Argus sent a note with the crate...What?? Argus wants me to PAY him? Bah! Well, friend, thank you for your help.
